name: ddd-expert
description: Adversarial EventStorming, conditional Tactical Design, implementation, and review

interface.longDescription: DDD workflow that facilitates the ten EventStorming steps one frontier decision at a time, challenges the integrated model, and synchronizes ready Models after explicit model confirmation; a real Design Delta adds confirmed collaboration sequences and claims before Codify, while Guard closes the realized records.
defaultPrompt: Use $ddd-expert:event-storming to facilitate the ten EventStorming steps on a temporary EventStorming Board. Ask one frontier decision at a time, recommend design choices with their strongest credible alternative, validate and write one meeting record with status: draft, summarize it for explicit user confirmation, then set status: ready and synchronize affected Models. Invoke $ddd-expert:tactical-design only for a real Design Delta; otherwise continue directly with $ddd-expert:codify.
